title: Email: Fw: Correction and question for Anthony from Tom Shaer

content.subject: Fw: Correction and question for Anthony from Tom Shaer

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: shaermedia@aol.com <shaermedia@aol.com>
Sent: Thursday, October 11, 2018 11:31 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Correction and question for Anthony from Tom Shaer 
 
Anthony,

I notice a mathmatic error which remains in your piece:
The unhappy ending was a foregone conclusion since that dramatic day on Sept. 4, which climaxed in a physical altercation following the Tigers’ 8-3 win over the White Sox. Two days later, FSD announced neither would be scheduled on telecasts for the remainder of the season.
The announcement by Fox that both guys would not work the rest of the year was made on 9/7, so that would be three days after the Sept. 4th incident, not two days. Just a little math here...
==========
Also, man, I have to ask you. How in the world did you decide to write these words in the second graph?
...depending on who you talk to, may or may not have ended in a choke hold...
The two witnesses said that never occurred. They were emphatic about that point.
